content: Hello! How can I assist you with your account today?
Hi, I need to reset the password for my account. I forgot it.
No problem. Could you please provide your username or the email linked to your account?
Thank you, jsmith87. I’ll send a password reset link to your registered email. Please check your inbox and click the link.
I got the email and clicked on the reset link. It’s asking for my date of birth to verify my identity.
That’s correct. Please enter your date of birth as it appears in your profile, then you’ll be able to set a new password.
I entered my date of birth and set a new password. Is that it?
Yes, you’re all set! You can now log in using your username and the new password.
